subject.title: fix(agent): harden execution and session boundaries

question: Should existing users receive the stricter taskless-resume exits, offline provider listing, tool-disabled discovery defaults, and fail-closed ambiguous model handling without a compatibility mode?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent, but these deliberate changes can stop previously tolerated automation and configurations; accepting that upgrade boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt stricter boundaries
options.body: Approve the new defaults with clear release context and exact-head validation of fresh and upgraded session/provider flows.

options.title: Add compatibility mode
options.body: Preserve current defaults and expose stricter exit, discovery, or fail-closed behavior through an explicit flag or configuration option.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Land terminal and credential-safety fixes while deferring provider and resume default changes to a separate proposal.

recommendation.title: Adopt stricter boundaries
recommendation.body: Approve the new defaults with clear release context and exact-head validation of fresh and upgraded session/provider flows.

likelyOwner.reason: They own both the current-main behavior and this follow-up implementation.
